title: The last stop before
logline: A stop with no name, before the city: a shelter, a bench, a schedule, a cigarette machine, a woman's back going into the bus, the last time the sequence draws her, closer than the rest stop, still from behind. The page counts the stops and stops counting.

panels.composition: A roadside bus shelter with a bench, a schedule case and a cigarette machine, a woman with a bag on her shoulder from behind stepping up into a bus's door.
